Name: T's Apartment House
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]Spend time with multiple spouses using "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]"![/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=5]This mod allows you to give multiple spouses their own private rooms![/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=3](You can use this mod even if you do not have multiple spouses or do not use the above mods.
It will work as a farmhouse map with lots of space and many rooms.)[/size][/color]
(Probably not compatible with multiplayer.)

There are some minor improvements, etc., due to the redaction of the farmhouse map.
Partitions can also be added using the settings in ModConfig.
Also, you can change the floors and walls of this map in much more detail than in the vanilla version.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Color this apartment with your spouses![/size][/color]

Changes to the farmhouse map will be applied starting with the second upgrade of the house.

The PSR specifications force the floor to be laid one tile below the spouse's room. This is added to all spousal rooms, and when you put the floor there yourself, it is all changed at the same time.
This looks weird in this mod, so we hide it by showing one extra tile between the spouse room and the hallway (black ceiling) than normal.


If the custom NPC is the spouse, he/she may not be able to enter the room due to furniture placement.
Please make a compatibility request for this as well.
We will probably be able to accommodate this soon!

[color=#ff0000][size=5]About option files when using PSR.[/size][/color]
The explanation given inside is also included here in case you are interested.
[quote]//★EN.Description★
//The character name on the right side of "name" determines who lives in which room.
//Since this is the case, you can freely change the placement by changing the character name on the right side of "name".
//Enter an appropriate string for unused rooms. (Please do not duplicate.)
//(e.g. "name": "None" or "name": "Null_01" or "name": "Null_02" etc.)
//The room numbers are counted from the left of each floor.
//Please do not edit any other fields except for "name".

//◆JP.Description. 日本語説明◆ 
//どの部屋に誰が住むかは"name"の右側のキャラクター名で決定されます。
//なので"name"の右側のキャラクター名を変更する事で、自由に配置を変更できます。
//未使用部屋には適当な文字列を入力してください。(重複しない様にしてください。)
//(例 "name": "None" や "name": "DaremoInai_01" または "name": "DaremoInai_02" 等)
//部屋番号は各階の左から数えます。
//"name"以外の項目は編集しない様にお願いします。[/quote][color=#ffff00]Also, if you are using custom NPCs or mods to change the names of characters, etc., there is a way to check if you do not know the name you should enter.[/color]

[list=1]
[*]On the title screen, delete "config.json" in the "PolyamorySweetRooms" folder.[/*]
[*]Load the save data.[/*]
[*]When loading is complete, a "config.json" file is generated, which can be opened in any text editor.[/*]
[*]The name in the "SpouseRoomOrder" field is the current spouse's name (ID Name). (In other words, this is the name that should be entered in the "Name" field of the options file.)[/*]
[/list]It may be a little confusing, in which case please refer to the video guide below.

Downloads.Description:
If you are using "PolyamorySweet" mod, please also install this file.
(Install only one.)
In this version, vanilla spouses are assigned to each room in order of name.
Recommended for those welcoming three or more spouses.

Mods.RelativePath: T's Apartment House\[PSR] T's Apartment House

Downloads.Description:
(Install only one.)
If you have 3 spouses or less, this one is recommended.
Up to three spouses are automatically assigned to rooms on the first floor in the order in which they were married.

Or for those who edit "content.json" themselves.

Mods.RelativePath: T's Apartment House\[PSR] T's Apartment House

Downloads.Description:
(Install only one.)
Use this option file if you want to assign a spouse to a trial function (42 rooms) using “PolyamorySweet”.
Spouses are not set by default, so you will need to edit “content.json” yourself.
